m: {Kermit} flails into the {Bathroom} of the {Warehouse}, stage manager of a musical whose only set, a tiny *shed*, cannot fit the chorus line. {Walter White} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar} to teach memory chemistry and sniffs one fizzing beaker too many. {Yoshi} waddles into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} as a *standing person* points at one lonely *swan*. {Cookie Monster} spots a *thorn* shaped like a cookie in the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive}, and his googly eyes spin. "Me want cookie!" {Yoshi} stands in {Front} of the {Lagoon} and, being short of arms, decides to **embrace** everybody with his long sticky tongue. {Tarzan} swings on a vine {Inside} the {Pool}, giving his jungle yell, and a puffing *runner* below copies his *footsteps* exactly. {Mario} pops out of a warp pipe in the {Basement} of the {Pool} and lands among a hundred squalling toddlers ruled by one stern *woman*. {Yoshi} flutter-jumps {Inside} the {Hangar}, trying to reach the top of a tall skinny *tree* glittering in the *sun rays*. {Chewbacca} roars {Inside} the {Beach} club, because the place is a mess and he likes things shipshape. {Sailor Moon} spins through her sparkly transformation in the {Bathroom} of the {Island} and, in the name of the moon, declares a **competition**: crabs must race along the *roof* while coconuts roll and gulls sprint. {Chewbacca} ducks into the {Bathroom} of the {Museum} just as a *runner* with a *grabbing hand* snatches the guide's notes, so he has to give the tour himself, in roars. {Chewbacca} tries to fix the flagpole in {Front} of the {Museum} while howling a Wookiee *song*. {Darth Vader} looms in {Front} of the {Tower} and raises one glove, and a giant *knife* floats off a picnic table on the Force. {Charlie Brown} trudges {Inside} the {Swamp} *shed*, exhausted, because a *tree* has eaten his kite and grown through the floor. Good grief. {Yoshi} hops {Inside} the {Boxing Ring}, his *upward gaze* fixed on a balloon drifting down a *road* of clouds. {Batman} glides down in {Front} of the {Boxing Ring}, pulls a freeze pellet from his utility belt and hurls it at a puddle of *water*. With a crack everything turns to **ice**, and long *icicles* grow from the ropes and the bell. Boxers skid helplessly past him, and he slides slowly away across the **ice**, still brooding, cape stiff as a board.

{Shrek} wants peace, so he stomps out in {Front} of the {Museum} and lets out one mighty roar that echoes off the *ruins*. Tourists, guards and pigeons all flee, and the whole place is **empty** at last: no tickets, no sandwiches, nobody. He sighs with bliss, until Donkey trots up asking why everything is so **empty**, and whether he can stay.

{Walter White} marches {Inside} the {Mansion}, where a bored *king* flips a *yuan coin* to choose a game **to play**. {Shrek} plonks down in {Front} of the {Beach} hut and declares that ogres are like onions, so a *woodcutter* splits one with his axe to **analyze** it. {Charlie Brown} runs up to kick a football in {Front} of the {Swamp} *cave*, but it is whisked away, and he sails through the air and crashes through the wall by the *chimney*, which coughs soot on him. Good grief: he has made a **window**. The frogs peer in and laugh, and a kite-eating tree reaches through the **window** to take his hat.

{Shrek} snores in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring}, hugging a *wine jug* of swamp juice under a sign saying "Go away". A falling *star* crashes through the ceiling and bonks him on the nose, and Donkey starts yelling in his ear, so he has **to wake up**. His furious roar makes everyone in the stadium **wake up** too, in their pyjamas.

{Chewbacca} bellows in {Front} of the {Beach} villa, and nobody understands a word except his *wife*, who parachutes in wearing a veil and a bandolier. She answers with a roar twice as loud. He fixes her deckchair, she rips it apart in joy, and the gulls agree that only a Wookiee **wife** could love that noise, so he hugs his **wife** until the sand shakes.

{Tarzan} swings into the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} and yells at a puddle that has begun **to seep through** the floorboards. {Gandalf} arrives in the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} meaning **to purchase** a boat, and the cranky old boatman will take only seashells. {Tarzan} swings into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} club, baffled by civilisation, and decides **to substitute** the jungle for all of it. Then the lifeguard goes to lunch, and Tarzan **substitutes** himself, yelling at the waves from a vine.

{Sailor Moon} arrives in {Front} of the {Island} hut, late and sobbing, with far more luggage than the place can hold. She lifts the *roof* like a lid to **stuff in** moon wands, spare tiaras, comics and a protesting Luna. {Naruto} faceplants in the {Basement} of the {Pool} for the hundredth time, because he never gives up: he will **strive** until his Rasengan finally spins. A worn-out *drudge* scrubbing the tiles lends one *strong arm* to haul him up, and off he goes again, clones cheering. {Shrek} flops against a shady *tree* in {Front} of the {Youth Hostel} and growls that all he wants is **to rest**. {Homer} waddles into the {Basement} of the {Pool} after the smell of doughnuts and finds a *crouching tiger* eating them. "D'oh!" His dim scheme is to paint on stripes and pose as a **tiger** to sneak the rest of the box. It backfires, because the real **tiger** falls in love with him and licks the icing off his bald head.

{Yoshi} flutter-jumps {Inside} the {Hangar}, legs whirring, with his sticky tongue stuck to a flag. A *helping hand* boosts him up into the *sun rays*, and each frantic kick helps **raise** the flag higher. Still stuck, he **raises** a plane too, then three mechanics, all dangling from one long tongue and cheering.

{Tarzan} swings from vine to vine {Inside} the {Pool}, following a *road* of *leftovers* that some picnic has dropped: half a sandwich, a banana skin, cold noodles. Baffled by the map, he eats it and asks a gull for the **route** instead. It squawks directions, the apes argue, and the whole troop hoots along the **route** to find a bear finishing the picnic.

{Chewbacca} is fixing a ship in {Front} of the {Inn} when a *standing person* climbs the wall with a ladder, then a hundred more, all coming **to invade**. He roars so hard his bandolier rattles and rips every ladder into toothpicks. They scatter, the guests cheer, and then Chewbacca smells the porridge and **invades** the kitchen himself.

{Shrek} trudges {Inside} the {Boxing Ring} and roars at the bell, so the referee locks him in wooden *stocks*. His **punishment** is not the custard pies the crowd throws. {Lara Croft} vaults into the {Bathroom} of the {Museum}, following a clue in an old *logbook* that says to tug the *silk thread* behind the sink. She tugs, and an ancient trap releases a rolling boulder of slime, which turns the statues **green** as she somersaults over it. Lara lands perfectly, ponytail and all completely **green**, holding the relic.

{Shrek} wants to be left alone in {Front} of the {Youth Club} when his *big brother*, an even larger ogre, turns up. {Shrek} bolts out of the {Bathroom} of the {Dunes} and down a sandy *road*, desperate to escape Donkey's talking. Yet Donkey's **rapid** chatter stays right beside his ear, asking whether they are there yet.

{Tarzan} swings into the {Bathroom} of the {Tower}, where a *big man* scolds him for wearing only a loincloth. Baffled, Tarzan grabs the man's own *flowing locks* to **cover** himself and wraps them round his waist. Apes arrive with armfuls of banana leaves to **cover** them both, and soon the pair is a large green bush arguing with itself.

{Mario} stomps on a turtle in the {Bathroom} of the {Tower} and keeps the empty *shell*. "Wahoo!" {Batman} crouches in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach}, gruffly timing two *twins* racing toward a *cross* scratched in the sand. {Walter White} strides {Inside} the {Lake} house and chalks up a chemistry question that no student has answered in thirty years. A *sparrow* opens its huge *mouth* and chirps the formula, the **only** correct answer he has ever heard. Pale with pride, Walter tips his black hat to it and declares it the **only** pupil worthy of his beakers.

{Gandalf} strikes his staff in the {Basement} of the {Pool}, and with a crack of spellwork the floor splits open into a green *valley*. Mountains heave up on both sides, a river runs down the middle and bewildered swimmers wander off among the sheep. He lights his pipe, sends fireworks over the **valley**, and blows a smoke ring that drifts the length of the **valley**.

{Lara Croft} leaps {Inside} the {Casino} and trips an ancient trap, and a huge stone **wheel** comes rolling after her. She flips onto a *cart*, ponytail flying, and it smashes through a *neat stack* of poker chips as she climbs a chandelier. The roulette table joins the chase, and she lands safely on top of the giant **wheel**, running backwards to steer it.

{Kermit} hops into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} looking for props and finds a secret *warehouse* under the tiles, stuffed with rubber chickens and spare banjos. "Yaaay!" he flails, trying to run the place like a show, but one tug on a banjo brings the shelves down. It's not easy being in charge of a **warehouse**, he sighs, buried in the **warehouse** chickens.

{James Bond} strolls into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} and clicks a cufflink from Q that does one absurd thing: it sniffs out sweat. It beeps along a *road* of damp footprints, every **trace** leading to a *sweating man* hiding under a towel. "Bond. James Bond," he says, without a **trace** of a crease in his tuxedo.

{Yoshi} clambers {Inside} the {Boathouse} and gulps down everything with his tongue: oars, ropes, buoys, and a *wart* off a passing toad. {James Bond} straightens his tuxedo in the {Bathroom} of the {Boxing Ring} and steps onto a *podium*, where a caped *big brother* challenges him **to compete**. {James Bond} pulls up at a *crossroads* in {Front} of the {Yeti Cave} and presses a button on a *jade tablet* from Q. {Cookie Monster} stamps one huge blue *foot* in the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, because a *standing person* is taking forever to unwrap a cookie. "Me want cookie! You **hurry**!" {Yoshi} sticks out his tongue {Inside} the {Mansion} to reach a melon at the far end of a *stretching road*. The {Joker} cackles in the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair}, winding up a giant *clam* full of joke-shop chattering teeth and leaving it out in the *rain*. {Chewbacca} is the most loyal friend in the galaxy, but in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} he finds his starship stuffed with tall *grass*, and it will not start. {James Bond} descends into the {Basement} of the {Piazza} in shiny *armour* from Q that does one absurd thing: it always has to come **first**. {Walter White} drops a tiny *standing person* into a beaker in the {Basement} of the {Lake} house, to show his class how a grow-in-water toy swells. {Mario} head-butts a block {Inside} the {Spa} and, instead of a coin, out flops a bundle of scratchy *hemp*. "Wahoo!" {Charlie Brown} sets out a kite and a gloomy picnic in {Front} of the {Swan Pond}, and of course the pond bursts its bank into a roaring *river*. Good grief. {Sherlock} holds a single crumb up on a *skewer* in {Front} of the {Funfair}, and smugly begins **to state** the facts while Watson takes notes. {Homer} is stuck in the {Basement} of the {Swan Pond} pavilion after a dim doughnut scheme, and a *rescue rope* of *silk thread* drops down to him. {Chewbacca} tries to stay **hidden** {Inside} the {Yen Exchange} behind a very small pot plant, which is hopeless, since he is eight feet tall and dripping *water drops* on the carpet. {Sherlock} steps through a creaky *gate* into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} and deduces from one crumb that a *person* is about to throw a custard pie. {Sherlock} sets up shop in the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} and deduces what each customer needs from a single crumb, while a *sparrow* yells his findings through its big *mouth*. {Darth Vader} breathes heavily in {Front} of the {Jungle} treehouse, ignites his red lightsaber and touches it to a tiny *campfire* in a jar. With a flick of the Force he drives a *nail* into the trunk and floats the jar up onto it: a **lamp**! The {Joker} cackles in {Front} of the {Funfair}, piling *gold coins* on a big *cross* painted on the ground with a sign saying "Free treasure". Under them he has hidden a **needle**. The {Joker} sneaks {Inside} the {Hut} wearing a false beard and pretends to be a **wise** hermit, leaning on a *snapped stick*, his grinning *mouth* full of riddles. {Lara Croft} flips into the {Bathroom} of the {Warehouse} and freezes, for ancient *silk thread* is strung between every shelf, and one lost *visitor* has just tripped it. A bell rings at the far end, then a boulder rumbles, because every strand is linked in one vast **network**. She climbs and somersaults through the **network**, ponytail flying, and plucks the relic from its centre.

{Darth Vader} raises a glove in the {Basement} of the {Beach} house as a huge wave crashes in, and the Force stops it dead over the *foundation*. The {Joker} swaps all the sunscreen in {Front} of the {Pool} for pots of *red lacquer*, and his squirting flower is loaded as well. {Casper} floats through a wall in {Front} of the {Island} lighthouse and says a friendly hello, frightening a man into dropping his sack of *soil*. It bursts into **dust**, which swirls and settles into one tiny *full stop* in the air. {Batman} crouches in the {Bathroom} of the {Tower} and scans a wriggling *parcel* with a gadget from his belt: no bomb, only a puppy. A *helping hand* reaches out to take it, but he growls, "I'll **hold** it," in that gruff voice. {Gandalf} taps his staff in the {Basement} of the {Pool}, and a fat *branch* leaps up under a spell and starts beating a giant *drum*. On every boom, fireworks shoot out of the **drum** and the water jumps out of the pool. Crankily he lights his pipe and mutters that he never did like a **drum** in the deep.

The {Joker} tiptoes {Inside} the {Beehive} with a *plumb line*, grinning, and checks every honeycomb cell is straight before he can **plant** a trick *tree* in each one. The bees sniff the little saplings, and each one squirts them with water and honks. He **plants** hundreds, cackling, and by the end the queen is wearing a whoopee cushion and the hive is a forest of pranks.

{Charlie Brown} trudges {Inside} the {Casino} fresh from summer *camp*, a boy so **pure** that he hands back his only winning chip in case it was a mistake. {Shrek} lumbers into the {Bathroom} of the {Piazza}, sweating, because it is high *summer* and his swamp has dried up. Like an onion he peels off one layer after another, grumbling that **summer** is for donkeys. Sure enough, Donkey is sunbathing on the cobbles in tiny sunglasses, singing about the **summer** at the top of his voice.

{Robocop} stands stiffly in the {Basement} of the {Funfair} while a *blade edge* tickles the steel over his *heart*. {Yoshi} licks a giant *page* off the floor in the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} and swallows it whole, words and all. {James Bond} strolls {Inside} the {Yeti Cave}, where a fallen *tree* burns down to glowing *embers* and trapped yetis whimper. The {Joker} skids into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} hauling poles of *bamboo* and a wooden *brace*, set **to build** the finest diving tower in town. The {Joker} deals out trick furniture {Inside} the {Hut}, starting with a *snapped stick* he has glued together, which he hands to a visiting hiker with a huge grin.
